title: THE FALLEN LUCIFER AND GOD'S ETERNAL TIME

blocks.text: THE FALLEN LUCIFER AND GOD’S ETERNAL TIME In this special writing let us consider unusual mysteries and prophecy, as a rush of events will be headed our way. As Jesus Himself said, “Behold I come quickly!” – “Meaning before this that events would occur very suddenly!” But first let us explain the mysteries.

“We see from Isa.14:12-15 and Ezek.28:11-19 that Satan was a ruler of an earthly kingdom way before Adam. And Lucifer’s reign existed in a long period between Gen. 1:1 and verse 2.” – “The Bible states that he fell in the sides of the North. (Polar Region) There was a cataclysmic destruction because of Lucifer’s rebellion against the Most High! (See Scroll #101.) – This was his first earthly kingdom, but evidently he had a secondary headquarters afterwards!” – So let’s study this mystery. – “There are legends and facts concerning the lost continent, Atlantis. Some scientists believe that it is the underwater remains of one of Lucifer’s pre-Adamic kingdoms. – Proof of this, they say, was confirmed in 1977 off the coast of Florida (and you can see the serpent’s head of Florida on the map; in other words, it forms a head that looks like a serpent) . . . when ocean explorers located an enormous pyramid, a colossal wonder, submerged in 1,200 ft. of water, larger than the Great Pyramid of Egypt! – It was found in the well-known area of the Devil’s Triangle, also known as the Bermuda Triangle! This is the area where strange events take place, wherein ships and planes have disappeared without a trace as if they had disappeared into another time dimension, researchers say. – Whatever the mystery, they have valid proof of much of this. Some say, evidently satanic forces at work!”

“Some have witnessed mysterious and multi-colored lights (like saucer craft) going in and out of the waters! . . . Also strange mist and fog have appeared, actually picked up by the radar, which proved it was solid rather than a normal mist!” . . . “From time to time there are other strange-like evils taking place in the area. – They suggested that a highly developed ancient civilization once existed in this area – one of Satan’s headquarters that God overthrew!” – “They claimed that some pictures revealed it was a capped pyramid. Of course this revealed Satan’s attempt to imitate and to defeat Jesus Christ, the real Head of the corner, the Capstone! (Matt. 21:42) – But the real ‘corner stone’ will be completed when Jesus returns!” – “Men claim a compass needle used in the Devil’s Triangle will point towards the North Star (true north) – rather than ‘the North Pole’ as in other areas!” – “The reason probably is because Satan still has a desire to be like the Most High God!” (Isa. 14:13-14) – “As time goes on men will make new discoveries and find more information and the Bible foretold there will be signs in the heaven, in the earth and in the sea!”

“Also there is a mystery concerning the bottomless pit. Evidently within the earth’s interior is some type pit!” (Rev. 17:8 – Rev. 11:7) – “And there could be a double mystery revealing space and earth locations! – The Scriptures unveil special places – ‘chains of darkness’ – ‘mist of darkness’ – and the ‘blackness of darkness’!” (II Pet. 2:4, 17 – Jude 1:13) – “These two Scriptures depict something similar to the ‘black holes’ in space wherein gravity is so intense that light can’t even escape nor anything else trapped within it!” . . . “Nevertheless here are some more Scriptures that describe some earthly pits!” (Rev. 9:1-2 – Rev. 20:1-3) – “So we see there is a great possibility that God has different type prison houses for different demons, fallen angels, unknown creatures and people!” – You will receive knowledge as you study these Scriptures; the Lord will reveal it to you!”

The mystery of time and light. (Read Scroll #88) – “Let’s consider Einstein’s theory of relativity concerning time, space and matter! According to him, if a spaceship could approach the speed of light (186,000 miles per second) – then like the other three dimensions, time too would disappear! – He felt if man could live through this he would escape into a different dimension! He felt possibly eternity! – But as we know there is only one way into eternity or eternal life, and that’s through salvation!” (I Thess. 4:17, 14) – “But the elect will outdo the speed of light and be in eternity with Jesus!” – “Be changed in the tinkling of an eye!” (I Cor. 15:51-52) – “There’s a considerable amount of information in the Scriptures concerning time, space and matter!”... “I feel that Einstein somehow studied these Scriptures in order to come up with the atomic formula ‘E = MC2.’ ” – II Peter 3:10, “where the heavens shall pass away with a great noise and the elements melt with fervent heat!” . . . This reveals the atomic structure is being split into fiery energy, because right above this Scripture, in verse 8, it speaks of time and relativity! . . . “That one day with the Lord is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day!” – In other words, in God’s eternal there is no time. You might say, all time is passed to Him, “He stays the same yesterday, today and forever!” (Heb. 13:8) – David said in Ps. 90:4, “For a thousand years in God’s sight are but as yesterday when it is passed!” . . . This helps to clear up a mystery in Heb. 7:9-10, “where it said that Levi paid tithes to God (Melchisedec) while he was yet in the loins of his father Abraham!” . . . “You see, to the Lord, that time had even already passed! – He had already seen Levi while he talked to Abraham, and Levi had not even been born yet!” . . . “We know time with the Lord is in an eternal dimension! – You see, earthly time has been allotted upon us, but not on the Almighty!” . . . Melchisedec was the Lord; because it says in verse 3, ‘without father, without mother, without descent, having no beginning or ending of life, but made like unto the Son of God’ . . . In other words, the eternal Lord Jesus. What a mystery!” – “In His throne kingdom there is no time, He sits between the cherubims, let the people tremble, let the earth be moved!” (Ps. 99:1) – “He sits in eternity and so will we that love Him; and time shall be no more for us!”
